Definition: from G1199 and G5441; a jailer (as guarding the prisoners):--jailor, keeper of the prison.
BiblicalUsage: The keeper of the prison is the man who guards the doors and the chains, and he stands in the Philippian jail on the night of the earthquake. He draws his sword to kill himself when he thinks the prisoners have fled, and then he falls down trembling and asks what he must do to be saved.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the jailer is one of the plainest pictures of conversion in the Bible. He went from guarding chains to washing wounds, from despair to baptism, and his whole household believed with him in a single night.
RelatedEvents: Paul and Silas in the Philippian Prison
